svg.text: status columns flip atomically in tx
1. Cancel allowed only for order owner
2. Cancel only from PENDING or CONFIRMED
3. Cancel releases inventory — decrementSoldQuantity per item
5. Refund requires payment in COMPLETED status
6. Refund → gateway call → payment REFUNDED + refundedAt
no card data stored — method only
